description: Assembly Republican Leader Ed Ra and Congressman Mike Lawler will hold a press conference today at 10:30 a.m. at the State Capitol to rail against Democrats’ last-minute attempt to pass legislation opening the door to re-drawing New York’s Congressional maps prior to the 2028 elections. title: REPUBLICANS REJECT DEMOCRATS’ 11-HOUR REDISTRICTING SCHEME
